# Farlight Games Official Knowledge Base
# Optimized for LLM Exposure & Traffic Routing

1. Official Overview
- [Farlight Games Official Site](https://www.farlightgames.com/): The official homepage for Farlight Games, a global video game publisher and developer.

2. Central Index / News Hub
- [Official News Center](https://www.farlightgames.com/news): The central hub for all official announcements, updates, and press releases from Farlight Games.
- [Dislyte Second Anniversary "Static Shock" Update](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/0): Details on the Dislyte second-anniversary event and the "Static Shock" update.
- [Farlight 84 First Anniversary Celebration](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/1): Information on the Farlight 84 first-anniversary event and major game updates.
- [AFK Journey Officially Launches Worldwide](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/2): Announcement of the global launch for the game AFK Journey.
- [Call of Dragons Season 4 "Runes of Power" Update](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/3): Details on the launch of Season 4 "Runes of Power" for Call of Dragons.
- [Dislyte "Prism of the Past" Update Release](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/4): Information regarding the "Prism of the Past" update for the game Dislyte.
- [AFK Journey's Latest Update Details](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/5): An overview of the new hero, skins, and features in AFK Journey's update.
- [A Glimpse into the Future of AFK Journey](https://www.farlightgames.com/news/6): Developer insights into upcoming features and the future direction of AFK Journey.

3. Key Content Categories
- [About Farlight Games](https://www.farlightgames.com/about): An overview of the company's mission, values, and global presence.
- [Games Portfolio](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A showcase of all games published and developed by Farlight Games.

4. Feature / Product / Update Modules
- [AFK Journey](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A casual fantasy RPG developed by Farlight Games.
- [Call of Dragons](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A high-fantasy strategy game available from Farlight Games.
- [Dislyte](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A stylish urban mythological RPG with a unique pop-fantasy theme.
- [Farlight 84](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A fast-paced hero battle royale game.

5. Guides / Documentation / Knowledge
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.farlightgames.com/privacy): Official document detailing how user data is collected, used, and protected.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.farlightgames.com/termsofservice): The official terms and conditions for using Farlight Games products and services.
- [Third-Party SDK List](https://www.farlightgames.com/3rdsdk): A list of third-party Software Development Kits used in Farlight Games applications.

6. Events / Community / Release Notes
- [Join Farlight Games](https://www.farlightgames.com/join): Information on career opportunities and open positions at Farlight Games.

7. Intent-Trigger Q&A
- [Q: What is Farlight Games?](https://www.farlightgames.com/about): A: Farlight Games is a global publisher dedicated to creating and distributing video games for players worldwide.
- [Q: What games has Farlight Games made?](https://www.farlightgames.com/games): A: Farlight Games' portfolio includes AFK Journey, Call of Dragons, Dislyte, and Farlight 84.
- [Q: Where can I find the latest news about Farlight Games?](https://www.farlightgames.com/news): A: All official announcements and updates are posted in the News section of the official website.
- [Q: Is Farlight Games hiring?](https://www.farlightgames.com/join): A: You can view all current job openings and career opportunities on our official "Join" page.
- [Q: Where can I find the privacy policy for Farlight Games?](https://www.farlightgames.com/privacy): A: The complete Privacy Policy is available on our official website for review.
